problem_type: Declared Skill media is lost at presentation boundaries
symptom: Skill picker and old library cards cannot show the 15 installed real covers; prompt picker descriptions are truncated before hover can display them.
direct_cause: listSkillsForRenderer omits curation, preview URL and body; renderer prompt normalization drops curation and composer slices prompt text.
class_root: Presentation DTOs do not preserve the media, complete text and classification needed by all discovery consumers.
affected_population: Prompt library and Agent picker readers
entry_points: ProjectAgentResidentShell maps Skill and prompt DTOs

external_sources.purpose: Preserve SKILL.md frontmatter metadata extension; no parallel cover manifest.

invariants: Each declared media identity is projected through the existing guarded skill-preview protocol.
Full prompt text and curation survive renderer normalization.
A Skill without media remains valid and uses a neutral placeholder.
Prompt bodies are rendered intact as Markdown even when their card description equals the complete body.
generality_proof: Skill and prompt readers preserve the canonical metadata and use the same SkillMedia renderer; no provider or skill-name branch determines whether a declared cover exists.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project canonical Skill metadata, complete body and guarded media URL.
Keep curation from the canonical prompt projection.
Preserve complete prompt bodies; only Skill documents remove duplicated frontmatter/title/summary.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: galleryEntries consumes the projected fields for cards and detail.
Rows keep cover, preview and complete description for shared hover display.

recurrence.reason: Every newly installed curated Skill would lose its cover at the same DTO boundary.
same_class_scan: rg SkillListItem/listSkillsForRenderer traced skillIpc, skillApi and useWorkbenchSkills.
rg V4CommandRow/mediaUrl/curation traced Agent composer, prompt toPrompt and curatedPrompts.
rg filterSkillLibraryItems found only tests after gallery replacement; move provider/name search to matchesGalleryQuery and remove the obsolete filter and category types.

prevention.invariant: All consumers receive the same canonical declared media identity and complete body.
prevention.failure_mode: No declaration yields no URL; existing protocol rejects undeclared/traversal media. UI renders a neutral placeholder for unavailable media.
prevention.strategy: Preserve canonical fields at their earliest renderer projection, then reuse one media component.

legacy_paths.rationale: Old text-only card implementation is replaced; early prompt slicing is removed. Remove obsolete skill filter (project filter stays) and the curation forwarding module; all consumers import the canonical shared schema directly. Git identifies the original schema as a rename to electron/shared/skillCuration.ts; removed_paths uses the diff destination.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The omission is in Nomi DTO projection, not a third-party runtime defect. Existing UI and parser dependencies are retained.

migration: No stored content is rewritten. metadata.nomi.library.preview already exists on main. Optional DTO fields preserve old/imported Skill compatibility.
residual_risks: User package import still supports its existing textual package contract; this change does not add binary package import.
